description: SIBAL microgravity tests added to the model's training data from Saffire flights I to IV (NTRS 20210011521, Table 2). They replace the duplicate PSI-98 and PSI-99 SIBAL rows, one of which had no recorded outcome. Quotes are checked by scripts/verify_cards.py.

discrepancies: PSI-99 lists samples 2-5 and 2-6 at 20 cm/s and about 22.1% O2, and PSI-98 lists Saffire-I at 21.5 to 21.7% O2; the paper's Table 2 gives 20 and 25 cm/s at 21% O2. The paper's values are used here.
